editorial:
Imagine being trapped in a high-tech building where one wrong move could get you killed. That is exactly what happens to a former hacker who gets forced into a deadly game. He has to break into some of the most secure banks in the world while sitting in a chair that is basically a ticking time bomb. While he is sweating it out, another man has to fight his way through a building filled with traps to save him. It feels like a high-stakes escape room mixed with a heist movie, and it keeps you on edge because you never know which trap will go off next.

The action moves quickly, and the tension stays high throughout the whole ride. While the plot is pretty simple, the thrill of the rescue mission makes it a fun watch. Some of the acting is a bit over the top, but it fits the vibe of a popcorn flick. If you love movies where characters have to solve puzzles under pressure, you will enjoy this one. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the rescue man manages to bypass the last few deadly traps and reaches the hacker just in time. They discover that the people running the game were using them for a massive financial scam. After a big fight with the villains, the duo manages to turn the tables and shut down the system. They escape the building right before it is locked down for good, leaving the bad guys to face the police.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and escape room challenges.
